shots.focal_element: Red-haired presenter (right) speaking to camera, hands on a wooden table; a second presenter sits left behind an open laptop
shots.what_happens: Locked-off wide two-shot in a warm, book-lined office set; the right presenter delivers VO words w82-w101 ('anywhere, either quickly on your computer, or you can hand off entire projects to agents that run in the cloud') with small hand gestures while the left presenter listens. No graphics or overlays. The last contact-sheet frame (0:26.500) already shows the next shot's close-up, so the cut sits a few frames before the stamped boundary.
shots.build_rebuild: Static 16:9 wide two-shot of two seated presenters at a wooden desk in front of a lit bookshelf with a warm pendant lamp in frame, shallow-ish depth of field, played as plain live footage with no overlay.

shots.focal_element: Agent's numbered plan (file paths highlighted) in Cursor's chat panel, then the diff view with the 'Commit & Create PR' button
shots.typography: Product UI text: a small, regular-weight sans-serif in sentence case for the chat body, with bold numbered headings in a blue monospace for file paths and inline monospace code chips; the diff pane uses a monospace code font with syntax colouring. The UI font looks like the system San Francisco face (low confidence).
shots.what_happens: Screen recording, scaled up so the chat text fills the frame, synced to w125-w145 ('look at changes, test them out, and then take them all the way to a merge PR'). The cursor hovers 'Review +2392 -1' (around 0:32), the view slides across to a split with the code diff (0:33.0 frame is mid-move), then lands on the changes list with route.ts imports, and the cursor moves to and clicks 'Commit & Create PR' (0:34-0:35). Two measured events match the reframe and the button hover or click. Exact pan easing is not visible from 2 fps stills.
shots.build_rebuild: Record the real app at high resolution, show it zoomed about 2x on the chat plan, then animate a horizontal camera pan onto the diff panel and end on a cursor click on the 'Commit & Create PR' button, timed to the VO line about merging.

shots.focal_element: Left presenter talking and gesturing at the table toward his co-host, who listens
shots.what_happens: A brief return to the conversational two-shot (a slightly wider version of s008, with the pendant lamp visible at top right) under w146-w153 ('You can dive deep when you really need'). It is a short human breather between two UI inserts.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut back for about 1.6 s to the same medium-wide two-shot of both presenters facing each other, so the UI demos are bracketed by live conversation.

shots.focal_element: Full Cursor window: agent chat on the left (prompt, demo video thumbnail, Summary and Testing lists) and a TSX editor on the right with a hover tooltip on MAX_PREFERRED_NAME_LENGTH

shots.what_happens: Unzoomed screen recording of the whole app window, timed to w154-w163 ('to, looking at changes, clicking around, going to a definition'). The cursor hovers a symbol to show its definition tooltip ('const MAX_PREFERRED_NAME_LENGTH: 128'), and around 0:38.5-0:39 the editor jumps to the top of the file, showing the import block and the constant's declaration line highlighted (go-to-definition). The chat pane stays static. The small code text is not fully legible on the sheet, so on_screen_text lists only the legible chrome and prompt.
shots.build_rebuild: Show the real IDE window full-frame with no zoom, hover a symbol to show its type tooltip, then trigger go-to-definition so the editor scrolls to the declaration with a line highlight, synced to the 'going to a definition' VO.
